title: 154. Remove Element

examples.explanation: Your function should return k = 2, with the first two elements of nums being 2 and 2.
Your function should return k = 5, with the first five elements containing 0, 0, 1, 3, and 4 in any order.

hints: Use two pointers: overwrite kept elements in a single pass by copying every element not equal to val to the front.
The elements beyond the returned length k can be anything; only k and the multiset of the first k matter.
